questions.question: Where does the Triwizard Cup take Harry and Cedric?
questions.note: Little Hangleton, by the Riddle family grave. Wormtail is waiting with a cauldron.

questions.question: Whose blood does the ritual use to give Voldemort a body again?
questions.note: Bone of the father, flesh of the servant, blood of the enemy. Wormtail cuts off his own hand for the flesh.

questions.question: Why do Harry's wand and Voldemort's wand lock together instead of casting normally?
choices: Harry is holding the Elder Wand
Both wands are made of yew
Snape jinxed the wands to lock
questions.note: Fawkes gave both feathers. The lock forces out echoes of Voldemort's victims, including James, Lily, and Cedric.

questions.question: Who spent the whole year disguised as Mad-Eye Moody?
questions.note: He drinks Polyjuice Potion and keeps the real Moody locked in a trunk. He put Harry's name in the Goblet and turned the Cup into a Portkey.

questions.question: What is Mad-Eye Moody's catchphrase in class?
questions.note: The impostor says it all year. He also makes the class watch the three Unforgivable Curses.

questions.question: Who writes the nasty Daily Prophet pieces about Harry during the tournament?
questions.note: Quick-quotes quill, acid-green robes. The film never shows that she is an unregistered beetle Animagus.

questions.question: Who does Cedric Diggory take to the Yule Ball?
questions.note: Harry asks her first. She tells him Cedric already did.

questions.question: What sign do the Death Eaters cast over the World Cup campsite?
questions.note: A skull with a snake coming out of its mouth. The match itself is not shown in the film. The attack on the camp is.

questions.question: Who is the Durmstrang headmaster, a former Death Eater who flees when Voldemort returns?
questions.note: He had named names to stay out of Azkaban. The Dark Mark on his arm starts to burn again.

questions.question: How old must you be to put your name in the Goblet of Fire?
questions.note: Dumbledore draws an Age Line around the Goblet. Cross it underage and it throws you back.
